newsitem.title: USA: IES shuts Duane Arnold, Iowa, power plant.
newsitem.headline: IES shuts Duane Arnold, Iowa, power plant.

text.p: IES Utilities shut its 538 megawatt (MW) Duane Arnold nuclear power station over the weekend for unscheduled repairs, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) Said Monday.
NRC, in its daily status report, said the unit was shut Saturday to correct "drywell leakage," and that the unit would be going into cold shutdown, suggesting a lengthy outage.
The power plant, in Palo, Iowa, was producing at full power Friday, the NRC said.
The company was not immediately available for comment on the cause of the outage or how long the unit was likely to be down.
IES Utilities is a subsidiary of IES Industries Inc.
